lastCompletedStory.title: Derive branch name in code as cam/issue-<N> with checkout -B and missing-issueNumber gate

nextStoryContext: US-001 done: deriveBranchName(issueNumber) in src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts returns 'cam/issue-<N>' (typeof number only, no slug, no fallback) and is the single source of truth for the feature-branch name; RunPostAuditOptions.branchName was REMOVED and replaced by issueNumber (unknown, read verbatim from prd.json) + writePrdBranchNameFn (optional, writes the derived name back into prd.json's branchName field BEFORE 'git add', called from executeGitProceedBranch). executeGitProceedBranch now spawns ['checkout', '-B', <derived>] (capital B, idempotent re-plan) instead of '-b'. The old empty-branchName guard was replaced by a missing-issueNumber gate (handleAuditApproved helper in plan-runner.ts): null/undefined/non-number issueNumber -> notifyFn + no-action, zero git calls. sidecar.ts's runPostPlanActions reads prd.json.issueNumber (not .branchName) and wires makeWritePrdBranchNameFn(cwd). test/plan-runner-empty-branch.test.ts (old contract) was deleted and superseded by test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-branch-derivation.test.ts. US-002 (planner/auditor template updates to the cam/issue-<N> contract + re-embed vendor) is next: it will touch templates/ + vendor/, so remember to run 'bun run embed-vendor' then 'bun run embed-vendor:check' for that story. scripts/file-size-budget.json ceilings were raised for plan-runner.ts (1272->1362) and sidecar.ts (2438->2461) with a CAM-236 tracker ref in _ref; a subsequent story touching either file may need another raise.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed 'git checkout -B <branch>' creates the branch if absent and resets it to the current start point (HEAD) if it already exists, instead of failing like '-b'; matches executeGitProceedBranch's idempotent re-plan usage.
